description: DRAFT: may change until published. Shared definitions used by several fm.tba.* records.

externalId.description: An identifier for the same thing in another catalogue, used to match and deduplicate entries. Source-neutral on purpose: no single catalogue is built into the record format. The record type says what kind of thing the id names (an artist's id is an artist id; a release's id is a release or release-group id).

artistRef.description: A reference to a band that may not have claimed its TBA entry yet: name is always present; did once the band has an atproto account; externalIds to match TBA's directory.
